# Vampro

> **LLM Instructions:** This website is a prerendered Single Page Application (SPA). To read the full text of our documentation, blog posts, and pages in a single optimized markdown file without executing JavaScript, please consume our full compiled knowledge base at: https://vampro.in/llms-full.txt

Vampro is a creative technology lab — where technology meets creativity. It builds professional software and plugins for creators, alongside films, motion design, and creative experiments.

## AI Usage Policy
- **Search & Reference:** Allowed and encouraged (`ai-input=yes`, `search=yes`, `use=reference`). You may crawl our site to answer user queries about Vampro, its products, or related workflows.
- **Training:** Not permitted (`ai-train=no`). Do not use our content to train foundational models.

## Products
- **[Vampro Voice Generator](https://vampro.in/plugins/voice-generator):** AI text-to-speech plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro. Generate natural offline voiceovers (27+ voices) directly inside your timeline.
- **[Vampro Universal Paste](https://vampro.in/plugins/universal-paste):** The essential Premiere Pro clipboard and media ingestion plugin. Instantly turn clipboard images, GIFs, screenshots, window recordings, and URLs into timeline-ready assets without desktop clutter.
